newsitem.title: USA: ClinTrials Research backs FY '96 EPS view.
newsitem.headline: ClinTrials Research backs FY '96 EPS view.

text.p: ClinTrials Research Inc chief executive William O'Neil said he is comfortable with analysts' consensus estimates for 1996 earnings of $0.65 a share.
O'Neil said he had "no problem" with the First Call consensus view.
He also backed a 1997 consensus range of $0.93 to $0.97 a share in earnings.
ClinTrials, a Nashville-based contract research company, reported fiscal 1995 earnings of $0.40.
For the first nine months of 1996, the company reported earnings of $0.42.
